project_title: CRISPR-Cas9 Mediated Gene Silencing in Arabidopsis thaliana

biological_agents.absa_reference: NIH Guidelines Appendix B-I-A, Section A-1
NIH Guidelines Appendix B-I-A, Section A-1

project_summary.experimental_procedure: Transforming Arabidopsis plants using Agrobacterium cultures via the floral dip method. Work with Mycobacterium tuberculosis will be conducted under BSL-3 conditions.
project_summary.containment: BSL-3 procedures will be followed for work with Mycobacterium tuberculosis in Greenleaf 402. Standard BSL-1 practices will be used for other agents in designated BSL-1 facilities.
project_summary.protective_equipment: For BSL-3 work with Mycobacterium tuberculosis: Respiratory protection (N95 or PAPR as required), double gloves, solid-front gown, and eye protection. For BSL-1 work: Standard lab coats, safety glasses, nitrile gloves, and enclosed footwear.
project_summary.transportation_methods: Sealed, shatterproof secondary plastic bins for transport to the greenhouse (BSL-1 agents). Transport of Mycobacterium tuberculosis will adhere to DOT and IATA regulations for infectious substances, utilizing appropriate primary, secondary, and tertiary containment, and transported only by authorized personnel.
project_summary.decontamination_methods: For BSL-3 work with Mycobacterium tuberculosis: Specific disinfectants effective against mycobacteria (e.g., 1:10 bleach solution with appropriate contact time, phenolic disinfectants) on all benchtops and equipment. All contaminated surfaces and equipment will be decontaminated before removal from containment. For BSL-1 work: 10% bleach solution on all benchtops, and other appropriate disinfectants for specific materials, following safety protocols.
project_summary.waste_disposal: For BSL-3 work with Mycobacterium tuberculosis: All infectious waste (solid and liquid) will be collected in biohazard bags/containers, sealed, decontaminated by autoclaving before removal from the BSL-3 facility, and then disposed of as regulated medical waste. For BSL-1 work: Solid biological waste is autoclaved before standard disposal; liquid waste is bleached for 30 minutes before pouring down the sink.
project_summary.spill_emergency_procedures: For BSL-3 work with Mycobacterium tuberculosis: Immediately notify other lab personnel. Evacuate area if aerosol likely. Cover spill with absorbent material, apply appropriate mycobactericidal disinfectant (e.g., 1:10 bleach solution with extended contact time), wait, then wipe up while wearing full BSL-3 PPE. Inform PI and EHS immediately. For BSL-1 work: Cover spill with paper towels, soak in 10% bleach, wait 20 minutes, then wipe up while wearing PPE.
